title: Banned Book Library in a Wi-Fi Smart Light Bulb
summary: A creative maker project that transforms a Wi-Fi smart light bulb into a covert banned book library, demonstrating steganography and distributed data storage techniques using IoT hardware as an unlikely data container.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how to hide sensitive information (banned books) in everyday IoT devices to bypass censorship and surveillance.
why_valuable: Shows innovative thinking about privacy, censorship-resistance, and covert data storage by repurposing mundane smart devices as secret data repositories.
